content:
Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has released the BCECE-LE 2026 1st Round Seat Allotment Result for Lateral Entry B.Tech counselling.

Allotment is based on BCECE-LE rank, choices filled, category, and seat matrix. The entrance exam was held on 31 May 2026; rank card was issued in June 2026. Round 1 choice filling was conducted in July 2026.

How to Check Allotment

  • Go to bcece.admissions.nic.in or bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
  • Open Round 1 Seat Allotment Result for B.Tech (Lateral entry) Counselling 2026
  • Login with application number and password
  • Download allotment order and complete fee payment / reporting as per board schedule

Candidates not allotted a seat in Round 1 may participate in subsequent rounds if announced by BCECEB.
